crop_image_center_plus_four: crop an image into four corner crops and a center crop using center_plus_four_crops
crop_image_center_plus_twohori: crop an image into left, right, and center crops using center_plus_twohori_crops
use_twohoricrop_module: use the TwoHoriCrop nn.Module to apply horizontal left, right, and center crops in a forward pass
get_image_size: get the width and height of a PIL or tensor image using _get_image_size
run_custom_transforms_main: run the custom_transforms module to crop a PIL image into multi-region crops and save them
